title: L2 TX: replace blocking lora_send() with lora_send_async() + TX_DONE completion
description:
Child of parent project-LICHEN-worker6-9hfe (async LoRa API refactor). Driver async TX ALREADY EXISTS (lr1110.c:484 lr1110_lora_send_async, lora_sim.c:426, lora_renode.c:272; Zephyr lora.h:244 lora_send_async) — do NOT touch drivers.

Scope (files): lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_tx.c, TX-side of lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2.c, lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_internal.h.

Work:
1. Replace blocking lora_send(lora_data.lora_dev, tx_buf, pop_len) at lora_l2_tx.c:352 with lora_send_async(); register a TX_DONE callback that transitions L2 state TXING->IDLE/RX and signals completion.
2. Completion semantics: current public TX path is synchronous (callers expect send completed or failed on return). Provide completion via k_sem taken by the synchronous wrapper OR an async completion callback API — pick one, document in lora_l2.h, and keep the existing public function signature working (wrapper waits on completion). No k_sleep-based waits; use K_FOREVER on the completion semaphore only in thread context (assert !k_is_in_isr()).
3. Error paths: TX_DONE with error status (driver callback args) must propagate errno like the blocking lora_send() return did; zeroize tx_buf after TX (lora_l2_tx.c:365 comment preserves this).
4. Concurrency: lora_l2.c:293-298 documents mutex ordering vs lora_send(); rework comments/locking for the async split (state snapshot under lock, actual radio op async).
5. Remove retry k_sleep() delays noted in parent description; retries (if any live in this path) become state-machine transitions, not sleeps.

Acceptance: rg -n 'lora_send\(' lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/ returns no blocking-send hits; ping_l2 and l2_dispatch tests pass; no k_sleep in tx path. Depends on A (project-LICHEN-worker6-sb0b) for shared lora_l2.c lifecycle/state — avoid merge collisions by sequencing.
